Stable SDL3-CS release for SDL 3.4.16, SDL_image 3.4.6, and the verified SDL_shadercross upstream main baseline.

This release rebuilds and validates the complete native RID matrix from the exact manifest source revisions. The SDL Metal fence correction previously carried as a downstream patch is included in upstream SDL 3.4.16, so the core package returns to an exact stable tag source.

## Package Versions

| Package family | Version |
|----------------|---------|
| `SDL3-CS` | `3.4.16.0` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>` | `3.4.16.0` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Image` | `3.4.6.9` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Mixer` | `3.2.4.11` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.TTF` | `3.2.2.11` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Shadercross` | `3.0.0.11` |

## Changes

- Added `First` and `Last` aliases for the supported SDL event groups, making event routing filters easier to express ([#276](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/276)).
- Updated the core native baseline and wrapper documentation to exact SDL 3.4.16, including the pen proximity state field and Android AAudio input preset hint ([#292](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/292)).
- Updated every Image native package to exact SDL_image 3.4.6 ([#293](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/293)).
- Updated every Shadercross native package to exact upstream `main@e55cf5e31ced6f3d1be5cc6d0c50e99384f9f4ba`, which contains the DirectXShaderCompiler discovery fixes without public header changes ([#294](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/294)).

Applications should update `SDL3-CS` and all platform-native package families to the versions shown above.
